purpose: Align P1 promotion with the official pooled row-level binary F1 objective while retaining dependence-aware uncertainty and empirical Public transport calibration. Per-day and station-layer minima remain visible transport diagnostics, but are not uncalibrated surrogate objectives.

official_metric_contract.metric: pooled row-level binary F1 over anomaly labels
official_metric_contract.primary_benefit: candidate pooled F1 minus incumbent pooled F1
official_metric_contract.source: distributed P1 README preserved in 00_MUST_READ_FIRST.md and README.md

hard_scientific_and_transport_gates.dependent_resampling_unit: joint KST-day blocks preserving station-layer observations and complete events

maximum_changed_fraction_any_kst_day.reason: No official mixture, safety loss, or operational action-cost calibration supports an equal per-day percentage veto; unequal and small day denominators create integer discontinuities.
report: maximum and quantiles of per-day changed fraction
number of days above the former threshold
maximum share and HHI of additions across KST days

minimum_each_supported_station_layer_del.reason: Requiring every group point estimate to be nonnegative changes pooled empirical risk into a worst-group objective. Such an objective is appropriate only when group robustness is explicitly intended and calibrated.
report: all station-layer row, positive, TP, FP, FN counts
per-group F1 deltas with dependence-aware uncertainty when estimable
worst-group point estimate and multiplicity caveat
unseen or unsupported deployment groups as Level-0 blockers

decision_states.PASS_PRIMARY_NO_WARNING: All validity/scientific/transport hard gates pass and no diagnostic warning is present.
decision_states.PASS_PRIMARY_WITH_TRANSPORT_WARNING: All hard gates pass, while at least one diagnostic-only day or station-layer warning is present; warning must be disclosed but cannot reverse the pooled decision.
decision_states.NO_PASS_PRIMARY_GATE: At least one validity-independent scientific or calibrated transport hard gate fails.
decision_states.QA_BLOCKED: A Level-0 validity or access-boundary gate fails; metrics are inadmissible.

primary_sources.claim: Repeatedly optimizing finite-sample selection criteria can produce selection bias; the prospective policy must be frozen and cannot reclassify v28.
Worst-group optimization is a distinct minimax objective, not a free safety check on average-risk evaluation.
Block resampling supports inference for dependent observations; P1 retains KST-day dependence-preserving bootstrap inference.
